audience: creators and publishers who run paid memberships with Memberful

useCases.title: Count active subscriptions per plan
useCases.text: Reads subscriptions with their status, plan and expiry date and counts them by plan. Also lists plans so the names and prices match.

useCases.title: Look up a member and their subscriptions
useCases.text: Finds a member by id, or lists members, with their profile, total spend, metadata, address and subscriptions with the plan of each.

useCases.title: List our plans, prices and passes
useCases.text: Lists the plans (the dashboard's Prices) with interval, price and for-sale flag, and the passes (the access groups members subscribe to).

useCases.title: Add a member or update their metadata
useCases.text: Creates a member from an email and an optional full name, or changes the metadata of an existing member.

useCases.title: Extend or shorten a subscription's access
useCases.text: Reads a subscription with its status and expiry, then changes the date when it expires, to give more time or end access earlier.

useCases.title: Create coupon codes for a discount
useCases.text: Creates one or more coupon codes for a discount you name by its id.
